steps.content: [Mountain Path]

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You know a way into the manor?
You look the plainly dressed girl up and down, your gaze finally settling on the crude map in her hands.
But sensing your attention, she quickly hides it behind her back while extending her other hand toward you, palm up.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Well, hand it over!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...What?
Your expression grows stern, while she stares wide-eyed at you, like you're not getting something obvious.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: My pay! I just helped you slip away from all those martial heroes, didn't I? Don't you know the rule? Aren't you supposed to show a little appreciation?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You helped me... just for this?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Oh... You wanna know why I helped you?
She leans in closer with a smile, pushing her outstretched hand forward again, rubbing her fingertips together.
You pull out some spare change that Schorl gave you and place it in her palm. She weighs it in her hand, then frowns and pouts.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Oh, young hero! I just rubbed dirt onto my face to cover for you, abandoning my dignity as a member of the Beggar Clan! I'm afraid... this here is not quite enough to soothe my wounded pride.
You sigh and pull out some more coins for her.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: To tell you the truth, I've always been a sickly girl, and there's a bunch of little kids constantly chasing after me for candy at the foot of the mountain... Winter's coming, and charcoal gets more expensive every day. If I can't save enough money, I might actually freeze to death in some alley...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Enough. Just tell me already.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Hehe, in fact, I helped you for one simple reason. Because... I know who you are.
Your heart skips a beat.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What do you know?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: I know... You're a huge martial arts fan, aren't you?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Huh?!

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Stop pretending! I could tell when I was telling those stories back at the tea stall. Your eyes lit up when I mentioned the legendary heroes and the secret codex! I know that look all too well!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: How could you tell I'm a martial arts fan?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Oh, I just can! After all, we're kindred spirits.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Everyone says that if you live virtuously and do good deeds, you will one day have your martial enlightenment and step into that dangerous but exciting world... How enchanting that sounds! But what about unlucky souls like us?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: I've tried countless ways, yet I'm still shut out from that world. And the longer I wait, the more obsessed I become! Even in my dreams, I see myself as part of the martial world. That's why you pretended to be a hero, isn't it? I heard how you got exposed at the inn. Trust me, I understand.
Her voice grows quieter, sounding genuinely melancholic.
If not for the way she's deftly stuffing the money she just collected into her pouch, you would have almost been fooled by her.
You catch a glimpse of her bag stuffed full of bottles and jars, and she notices your gaze.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: These? They're medicines I have to take every day. I wasn't lying when I said I'm sickly. I can't become a hero because of my poor constitution. Everyone in Ping'an Town knows.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You didn't come to Northsnow Manor just to get inspiration for new stories to tell the children, did you? I remember you mentioning that the manor master was also once sickly. Do you believe that...

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Yes! I want to see with my own eyes whether that codex can truly change fate and transform someone like me into a genuine hero!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The codex...
If there really exists a special item that can transform an ordinary person into a Sinner, could it be exactly what you're looking for?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: What about you? What brought you here?

steps.speaker: Chief
options: I want to dominate the martial world!

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Alright, alright, I won't press you! A true hero always keeps a secret or two. At least tell me what I should call you?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Just call me ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Wait, is that your real name? Hmm... Well, if we're venturing into the manor, we must take our roles seriously. I'll call you ${PlayerName} the young hero! And you can call me Master Shuang'er!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...I'm not sure I follow, but sure.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Are you ready to begin our martial world adventure, young hero?
Following the crude map, she leads you to one side of the manor's entrance and steps aside to reveal a hole only big enough for a dog to pass through.
Martial heroes, Sinners, the manor, the codex, and the illicit trade in the Outlands during these tense times... What lies beyond this opening may satisfy the world's curiosity.
Against your chest, Schorl remains silent. You'll likely have to face whatever comes next on your own.

The entrance is narrow, barely wide enough for one person to crawl through. Snow mixed with ice shards scrapes against your clothes, sending a chill through your bones. Just as your breathing grows labored, a cold wind suddenly blows from ahead, and white light spreads around you...
[Manor and BGM] Manor environment rendering, heavy snow rendering

Dark blue stone rises into towering walls, while curved eaves and ornate brackets stretch through the curtain of snow. In the open courtyard with clean stone paths, old plum trees thrust their branches toward the gray sky like firm brushstrokes. Even the dense snow cannot conceal the manor's serene, imposing presence.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: I've always heard that Northsnow Manor is like a fairyland... So the stories are true.
